name: Nick Nemeth
biography: Nicholas Theodore "Nick" Nemeth is an American professional wrestler and stand‑up comedian, currently signed to Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) under his real name, Nic Nemeth. He is best known for his WWE tenure from 2004 to 2023 as Dolph Ziggler, amassing multiple championships, including two World Heavyweight titles, six Intercontinental titles, and the 2012 Money in the Bank winner, before debuting in NJPW and TNA in 2024.
